name: com.zainsaeed/hire-zain
title: Zain Saeed: hire a web developer
description: Hire Zain Saeed (Fiverr Millionaire) for WordPress, Shopify and Next.js: services, work, quotes.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Who Zain Saeed is: background, credentials (Fiverr Millionaire, Shopify Partner, Fiverr Pro, Upwork Top Rated), how he works, industries he serves, what he does not offer, and links to his portfolio, reviews and profiles.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The services Zain offers (WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, web apps, speed optimization, migrations, Webflow, white-label work for agencies, a free 3-page website) with a link for each. Zain does not publish prices; each project gets a fixed quote. Pass a search word to narrow the list.

search.description: Optional word to filter by, for example "shopify" or "migration".

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: Real client projects Zain has built, with location, industry, tech used and a link to each case study. Pass a search word (industry, platform or country) to narrow the list.

search.description: Optional word to filter by, for example "shopify", "contractor" or "UK".

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Emails the user's name, email address and project details to Zain so he can reply with a fixed-price quote, usually within 24 hours. The request goes only to Zain and is used only to reply to it.

email.description: Email address Zain should reply to.

project.description: What they need built or fixed, in a few sentences.

service.description: Optional. Closest service, for example "Shopify development".

timeline.description: Optional. When they need it, for example "within 4 weeks".
